title: SCREEN SHAKE, BRIGHTNESS AND SHOW FPS
why: His order: add all of this to Settings. Display gets three rows. SCREEN SHAKE is OFF, LIGHT, STANDARD or STRONG: off holds the picture still through blasts and heavy hits, strong shakes it half as hard again, and standard is how it has been. BRIGHTNESS is DARKER, STANDARD, BRIGHTER or BRIGHTEST and lifts or sinks the shadows of the world, which is what a night raid needs, without touching the menus and the HUD; at standard the picture is untouched. SHOW FPS puts a small frame rate plate in the top left corner of every screen. They change at once and are saved with the profile; in the DEMO they hold for the session.
now: Display has screen shake, brightness and show fps.
